xna-type.name: AvailableNetworkSession
xna-type.summary: Describes a multiplayer session that can be joined.
xna-type.remarks: Use the NetworkSession class to get a list of AvailableNetworkSession instances. Typically, the results populate some type of user interface, displayed by the game. The user then chooses a session, and the game adds the player to the chosen session with a call to Join .

property.name: CurrentGamerCount
property.summary: Gets the number of gamers in the session.

property.name: HostGamertag
property.summary: Gets the gamertag of the session host.

property.name: OpenPrivateGamerSlots
property.summary: Gets the number of private player slots. These slots are reserved for people joining by invitation or friend presence.

property.name: OpenPublicGamerSlots
property.summary: Gets the number of public player slots. These slots are reserved for people joining by a matchmaking service.

property.name: QualityOfService
property.summary: Gets an estimate of the quality of network service between this local machine and the remote session.
property.remarks: This measurement can take some time to complete, so the data may not be available when the search result is first returned to you.

property.name: SessionProperties
property.summary: Gets any custom properties that have been attached to the session.
